I've been playing Wing Commander again for Youtube, and it's simply an amazing game that is so far ahead of it's time. First off, it has an incredible suspension of disbelief. It feels like an actual place you are visiting. You talk to people in the lounge, they respond to events happening in the game. Characters can die if you don't cover their ass on missions, and people respond accordingly. Instead of a save/load screen, you goto sleep or wake up a character in the barracks. Even the mission cutscenes are great, watching your fighter take off in perfect condition, and come back showing however much battle damage you took.

Plus it had branching missions! Based on your success or failure, you would jump to different systems and have to handle different missions. And you actually could fail missions! If a mission was too difficult, you had the option to fail, run away, and just land. The game and the story would take that into account. The war effort and the game would move on.

The gameplay was top notch too. The different fighters really felt different enough to impact how you'd pilot them. The different enemies handled rather uniquely as well, forcing you to adjust your tactics to them. I love it.

The game even had 2 expansion packs, which are way too hard for me, released in around a year?

I know Star Citizen is a much more ambitious game, but I really wish he just stuck to his original pitch of Squadron 42. I want more of that. Not another boondoggle MMO.
